candidate.claim: CancelToken executor guard is inverted: first cancel() returns early and never sets token.reason, so cancellation never happens.

verifier.reason: The guard at cancel/CancelToken.js:55 returns when token.reason is falsy, which is its initial state, so the assignment at cancel/CancelToken.js:60 and resolvePromise at cancel/CancelToken.js:61 are unreachable on the first and every subsequent cancel() call.

candidate.claim: spread passes the whole array as a single argument instead of spreading it into callback arguments.
candidate.title: spread does not spread array

candidate.claim: isAxiosError returns true for any object because missing isAxiosError (undefined !== false) passes the check.

verifier.reason: At helpers/isAxiosError.js:13 the only checks are utils.isObject(payload) and payload.isAxiosError !== false, so an ordinary object without the property yields undefined !== false and returns true.
